# `armada`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

armada manages apps, jobs, and the cluster they run on. Every command is
`armada NOUN VERB`, such as `armada app deploy` or `armada secret set`. It
talks to the control plane with the credentials in --config and needs no
root. Machines run `armadad`.

## Global flags

Every command takes these.

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-A`, `--all-spaces` | every space |
| `--config string` | client config file (default `$ARMADA_CONFIG, else ~/.armada/config if it exists, else /etc/armada/admin.config`) |
| `--space string` | space to work in |
